## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete problem and what this change provides. Link the relevant issue.

## Validation

Describe checks run and their results. For audio changes, distinguish synthetic
tests, physical measurements, predicted responses, and actual verification.
State hardware/routing details and remaining uncertainty when relevant.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope respects the architecture and current milestone.
- [ ] Repository checks and applicable behavior tests pass.
- [ ] Documentation describes limitations without unverified accuracy claims.
- [ ] New dependencies include license and distribution implications, if applicable.
- [ ] Changes to audio/configuration preserve cancellation, bypass, and restoration, if applicable.
- [ ] Shared fixtures/logs contain no private recordings or identifying metadata.
